original_title: Activision Teases Imminent Call of Duty Modern Warfare Reveal With Video Showing Korean Setting
summary_en: Activision has dropped a cryptic video teasing the next installment in the Modern Warfare saga, strongly suggesting a dramatic shift in setting. Fans are speculating that the series could be heading to the Korean Peninsula for its next major conflict.

en.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Hints at Korean Setting
en.summary: Activision has dropped a cryptic video teasing the next installment in the Modern Warfare saga, strongly suggesting a dramatic shift in setting. Fans are speculating that the series could be heading to the Korean Peninsula for its next major conflict.
en.body:
The familiar thunder of boots on pavement and the rattle of automatic gunfire might soon be replaced by the sounds of a different kind of conflict. Activision has ignited the rumor mill with a mysterious video feed, seemingly pointing towards a significant new setting for the next **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare** title. While official details remain scarce, the breadcrumbs left behind by developer **Infinity Ward** are leading many to believe the franchise is poised to explore the complex geopolitical landscape of Korea.

For years, the **Modern Warfare** sub-series has been synonymous with gritty, contemporary warfare, often drawing inspiration from real-world conflicts and tensions. Since its explosive debut in 2007, **Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare** redefined the first-person shooter genre, and its sequels have continued to push boundaries, albeit with varying degrees of success. **Infinity Ward** has consistently been the driving force behind the rebooted **Modern Warfare** timeline, which began in 2019. They've already confirmed that this year's entry will be a definitive **Modern Warfare** experience, and crucially, will be exclusive to current-generation consoles, finally leaving behind the last-gen hardware.

## A Glimpse of the Peninsula

The latest tease comes in the form of a YouTube video uploaded to the official Call of Duty channel. Titled "Camera 04," the feed showcases what appears to be an urban environment, with visual cues strongly suggesting a South Korean setting. A digital banner on the left side of the footage displays a series of numbers: 26-06-07 and 04-13-26. The former prominently aligns with the date of Microsoft's upcoming Xbox Games Showcase on June 7, 2026 – a likely venue for a full reveal. The latter set of numbers, when interpreted through alphabetical order, spells out DMZ, hinting at the potential inclusion or evolution of Call of Duty's popular extraction mode.

This visual data, coupled with persistent rumors and leaks, paints a compelling picture. Insider reports, notably from leakers like TheGhostOfHope, have been circulating for months, suggesting the game's title might even incorporate a Korean character for the number four, potentially being named "Modern Warfare 사" (where '사' is the Korean word for four). These whispers indicate a campaign that could span both North and South Korea, offering a narrative depth that explores the unique tensions and historical context of the divided peninsula. The development on next-gen Xbox dev kits further solidifies the commitment to a current-gen-only experience, promising a visually and technically advanced title.

## What This Means for the Franchise and Fans

The prospect of a **Call of Duty** game set in Korea is a significant one. It offers a departure from the more familiar Middle Eastern or Eastern European locales that have often served as backdrops for the franchise. A Korean setting could introduce unique environmental challenges, distinct urban combat scenarios, and a narrative deeply rooted in a region with a complex and often volatile history. For hardcore fans who pore over every detail of franchise lore and developer history, this potential shift is incredibly exciting, promising fresh storytelling possibilities and a chance to engage with a new geopolitical stage.

Casual players, meanwhile, will undoubtedly be drawn to the promise of cutting-edge graphics and intense multiplayer action, now set against a novel and visually striking backdrop. The decision to forgo last-gen consoles also signals a clear commitment to leveraging the full power of the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, potentially leading to more immersive environments and sophisticated gameplay mechanics. The question of a Nintendo Switch 2 release remains open, especially given Microsoft's 10-year agreement to bring Call of Duty titles to Nintendo platforms, though past exclusivity for **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** suggests it's not a certainty.

## The Road Ahead

With the Xbox Games Showcase on June 7, 2026, looming, the anticipation for an official reveal of the next **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare** title is palpable. All signs point to this date being the moment Activision and **Infinity Ward** pull back the curtain, confirming the Korean setting and likely revealing the game's official title and the first glimpses of its gameplay. Until then, the cryptic video feed and the persistent whispers from the community will continue to fuel speculation about what could be the most geographically distinct **Modern Warfare** installment yet.

tr.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Kore Ayarını Öne Sürüyor
tr.summary: Activision, gizemli bir videoyla Modern Warfare serisinin bir sonraki bölümünü öne sürdü. Hayranlar, serinin bir sonraki büyük çatışmasının Kore Yarımadası'nda geçebileceğini düşünüyor. Bu, serinin coğrafi olarak en farklı bölümü olabilir.
tr.body:
## Kore Yarımadası'na Doğru
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare serisi, yıllardır gerçekçi ve güncel savaşla özdeşleşmiştir. 2007'de çıkan ilk oyun, first-person shooter türünü yeniden tanımladı ve devam oyunları sınırları zorlamaya devam etti. Infinity Ward, 2019'da başlayan Modern Warfare zaman çizelgesinin arkasındaki güç olmuştur. Bu yılki girişin, kesin bir Modern Warfare deneyimi olacağını ve kritik olarak, yalnızca mevcut nesil konsollara özel olacağını zaten doğruladılar.

## Bir Anı Yakalamak
Son ipucu, resmi Call of Duty kanalına yüklenen bir YouTube videosu ile geldi. 'Kamera 04' adlı video, görünüşte bir kentsel ortamı gösteriyor ve görsel ipuçları güçlü bir şekilde Güney Kore ayarını öneriyor. Videonun sol tarafındaki dijital banner, 26-06-07 ve 04-13-26 numaralarını gösteriyor. İlki, 7 Haziran 2026'da yapılacak Xbox Games Showcase'nın tarihini açık bir şekilde ortaya koyuyor - muhtemelen tam bir açıklamanın yapılacağı yer. İkincisi, alfabetik sırayla yorumlandığında DMZ'yi oluşturuyor, bu da Call of Duty'nin popüler çıkarma modunun potansiyel olarak dahil edileceğini veya geliştirileceğini ima ediyor.

Bu görsel veri, sürekli dedikodular ve sızıntılarla bir araya gelerek inandırıcı bir tablo çiziyor. İçeriden gelen raporlar, özellikle TheGhostOfHope gibi sızıntı yapanların aylık raporları, oyunun adını Kore karakteriyle dört sayısını içerebileceğini öne sürüyor - potansiyel olarak 'Modern Warfare 사' (burada '사', Korece dört sayısı için kullanılan karakterdir). Bu fısıltılar, hem Kuzey hem de Güney Kore'yi kapsayan bir kampanyayı öneriyor ve böylece bölgenin benzersiz gerilimleri ve tarihi bağlamını keşfeden bir anlatı derinliği sunuyor. Oyunun next-gen Xbox geliştirme kiti üzerinde geliştirilmesi, yalnızca mevcut nesil konsollar için bir deneyim sunma taahhüdünü pekiştiriyor ve görsel ve teknik olarak gelişmiş bir başlık vaat ediyor.

## Bu, Franchise ve Hayranlar için Ne Anlama Geliyor
Call of Duty'nin Kore'de geçmesi önemli bir gelişme olabilir. Daha alışık olduğumuz Orta Doğu veya Doğu Avrupa lokasyonlarına bir alternatif sunabilir. Kore ayarları, benzersiz çevresel zorluklar, farklı kentsel savaş senaryoları ve bölgenin karmaşık ve souvent volatil tarihine derinlemesine bağlı bir anlatı sunabilir. Franchise'nin lore'ünü ve geliştirici tarihini inceleyen سخت çekirdek hayranlar için bu potansiyel değişim, heyecan verici bir gelişme olabilir ve taze hikaye anlatımı olanakları sunabilir. Casual oyuncular ise, yenilikçi grafikler ve yoğun multiplayer aksiyonunun vaat edilen bir novel ve görsel olarak çarpıcı arka plana karşı çekilecektir. Son nesil konsollara odaklanma, ayrıca PlayStation 5 ve Xbox Series X/S'in tam gücünden yararlanmaya yönelik net bir taahhüt sinyali veriyor ve daha da immersif ortamlar ve sofistike oyun mekanikleri vaat ediyor. Nintendo Switch 2 sürümü konusunda ise Microsoft'un Call of Duty başlıklarını Nintendo platformlarına getirmeye yönelik 10 yıllık anlaşmasıyla birlikte bir belirsizlik bulunuyor.

## Yol Haritası
7 Haziran 2026'da yapılacak Xbox Games Showcase ile birlikte, bir sonraki Call of Duty: Modern Warfare başlığının resmi açıklaması için heyecan doruğa ulaşıyor. Tüm işaretler, bu tarihin Activision ve Infinity Ward'ın perdeyi açacağı, Kore ayarını onaylayacağı ve oyunun resmi adını ve ilk gameplay görüntülerini ortaya koyacağı ana işaret ediyor. O zamana kadar, gizemli video akışı ve topluluktan gelen sürekli fısıltılar, coğrafi olarak en farklı Modern Warfare bölümü olabilecek şey hakkında spekülasyonu devam ettirecek.

content_raw: Activision has teased an imminent reveal of the next Call of Duty Modern Warfare game with a YouTube video that suggests Korea as a setting. The official Call of Duty YouTube channel has gone live with a video feed from “Camera 04,” showing what may be a multiplayer map set in urban Korea. The banner on the left of the footage includes a set of numbers, including 26-06-07, which is the day of Microsoft's upcoming Xbox Games Showcase (June 7, 2026). The other set of numbers, 04-13-26, could relate to the numbers of the alphabet, as they spell out DMZ, the name of Call of Duty's extraction mode. There’s not much else to go on, but this new video going live today, May 28, certainly suggests a reveal is imminent. Developer Infinity Ward has already confirmed this year’s Call of Duty is a new Modern Warfare, which is rumored to be Modern Warfare 4. “Yes, we are making the definitive Modern Warfare,” Infinity Ward tweeted earlier this month. It’s worth noting that Infinity Ward has said that this year’s entry will not release on last-gen consoles , confirming that the hugely popular first-person shooter franchise has finally, properly moved onto the current generation (PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S). What remains unknown at this time is whether the new game will be released on Nintendo Switch 2. A year ago, both Activision and Nintendo were said to be working on getting Call of Duty on Switch , but that never happened for 2025’s Black Ops 7. In February 2023, Microsoft signed a 10-year agreement to bring Call of Duty to Nintendo gamers “the same day as Xbox, with full feature and content parity.” The agreement was part of Microsoft’s effort to get its $69 billion acquisition of Activision Blizzard over the line in the face of resistance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and other regulators across the globe. The concern was that Microsoft might have pulled Call of Duty from PlayStation, or made the game on rival platforms inferior in some way. Promising to release Call of Duty on Nintendo consoles was designed to show Microsoft’s commitment to making Call of Duty as accessible as possible to as many gamers as possible. Is now finally the time to make good on that promise? It's also worth noting that this year's Call of Duty will not launch day one on Game Pass, Microsoft's subscription service . New Xbox boss Asha Sharma had decided to pull new Call of Duty launches out of Game Pass, instead added them in a year later, while cutting the price as part of a wider effort to rebuild the brand in the eyes of hardcore fans. Infinity Ward has new co-studio heads going into the launch of this year’s game. Jack O’Hara, who came up in production, has been at Infinity Ward since 2012, while Mark Grigsby made his name in animation starting back in 2005, though he left for a stint at Respawn Entertainment before returning in 2012.
